checks.title: CSP connect-src scope
checks.detail: connect-src allows any https/wss origin because the user may point the wallet at their own RPC (HTTP + its WebSocket); script execution stays self-only, so this cannot load code.

checks.title: CSP img-src scope
checks.detail: img-src allows https so token logos from DexScreener render; images cannot execute script and referrer/URLs are external-visible.
